[EN] I've located the transports.

It took more time to come here and report than it did to track them down.
[ES] He localizado los transportes.

Me tomó más tiempo venir aquí y reportarlo que rastrearlos.

[EN] This place is safe, thanks to you.
[ES] Este lugar es seguro, gracias a ti.

[EN] There's no time to hesitate...!
[ES] ¡No hay tiempo para dudar...!

[EN] Hurry. The villagers need our help!
[ES] Date prisa. ¡Los aldeanos necesitan nuestra ayuda!
